claim: cars24.com collects the challan amount and settles it on the user's behalf; the page states no fee, timeline or refund terms
quote: Pay the due amount online, and Cars24 will settle the challan.

claim: CarInfo lists challan payment as a third-party affiliate service used at the user's own risk; no timeline, fee or partner named
quote: Carinfo also features certain services provided by its third-party affiliates, including: … Traffic Challan Payment

claim: CarInfo refund policy: challan payments are non-refundable once processed
quote: all digital services, including insurance, FASTag, challan payments… are strictly non-refundable and non-cancellable once processed.

claim: VehicleInfo pays challans through unnamed partners (developer reply on Google Play, 2026-04-24)
quote: VehicleInfo collects challan payments and pays them to the respective RTO via secure, authorized partners

claim: A challan forwarded to the Virtual Court can still be paid online on the government site
quote: This challan has been forwarded to Virtual Court (https://vcourts.gov.in/), but still it can be paid here.

claim: Supreme Court, S. Rajaseekaran v. Union of India (28 Sep 2026, 2026 LiveLaw (SC) 1007): states to blacklist vehicles with unpaid e-challans on Parivahan and block ownership transfer
quote: The authorities should also proceed to block ownership transfer.

claim: Spinny's challan provider (Pureride) does not guarantee settlement
quote: Pureride does not guarantee or make any representations that the challans shall be settled

claim: RBI Payment Aggregator directions require extra charges to be shown before payment (whether challan apps are PAs is untested)
quote: shall ensure that any charges, other than the price… are distinctly displayed to the payer prior to the transaction

claim: A separate draft CMV amendment would mark vehicles with final unpaid challans 'Not to be Transacted'; not yet notified. (G.S.R. 48(E), in force 21 Jan 2026, covers challan issuance and DL disqualification only.)
